description: Telecom network dataset containing 100,000 network observations with network performance, availability, operational, security, environmental, geographic, and fault-related attributes.

Season.description: Season associated with the network observation.

Cell Availability (%).description: Percentage of time the network cell is available.

MTTR (hours).description: Mean Time To Repair for a network issue.

Packet Loss Rate (%).description: Percentage of packets lost during network transmission.

Call Drop Rate (%).description: Percentage of calls that are unexpectedly dropped.

Handover Success Rate (%).description: Percentage of successful handovers between network cells.

Alarm Count.description: Total number of network alarms recorded.

Critical Alarm Count.description: Number of critical network alarms recorded.

Parameter Changes.description: Number of network parameter changes recorded.

Successful Configuration Changes (%).description: Percentage of network configuration changes completed successfully.

Data Usage (GB).description: Amount of data consumed by network users.

User Count.description: Number of users associated with the network observation.

Connection Setup Success Rate (%).description: Percentage of successful network connection setup attempts.

Temperature (°C).description: Environmental temperature associated with the network observation.

Humidity (%).description: Environmental humidity associated with the network observation.

Weather.description: Weather condition associated with the network observation.

Issue Reported.description: Indicates the reported issue status/type represented in the dataset.

City.description: City associated with the network observation.

State.description: State associated with the network observation.

Zip.description: Postal/ZIP code associated with the network observation.

Fault Occurrence Rate (%).description: Rate at which network faults occur.
